# androidx.webkit (license only)

An Android app's Gradle build adds `androidx.webkit:webkit` from Google's Maven repository for the WebView's message
ports and start scripts (`ANDROIDX_WEBKIT` in crossbind's `actions/gradleProject.js`). Gradle leaves the AAR's license
out of the app; this folder keeps it, which `crossbind licenses` quotes.

- Upstream: https://developer.android.com/jetpack/androidx/releases/webkit
- Version: `1.17.1`
- License: Apache-2.0, see `LICENSE`, the AAR's `META-INF/androidx/webkit/webkit/LICENSE.txt`,
  sha256 `809fa1ed21450f59827d1e9aec720bbc4b687434fa22283c6cb5dd82a47ab9c0`

An update of the library changes this folder too.
